title: Quantum Enhanced Numerical Homogenization
summary: We propose a numerical homogenization method for scalar linear partial differential equations with rough coefficients that integrates classical coarse-scale solvers with quantum subroutines for fine-scale corrections. Inspired by the Localized Orthogonal Decomposition, we employ quantum local problem solvers to capture fine-scale features efficiently. Unlike periodic homogenization approaches, it does not rely on any periodicity assumption.
